The petitioner has filed the present writ petition seeking for the following reliefs:
a) "Issue a writ in the nature of mandamus or any other writ or direction, by directing the respondents to consider the request/representation dated 23.01.2023 made by the petitioner to respondent No.2 vide Annexure-B, as per Section 31 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013, in the interest of justice and equity.
b) Pass any such appropriate order as this Hon'ble court deems fit just and proper in the circumstances of this case, in the ends of justice."
2.

sentences.text:
It is the case of the petitioner that he is the owner of the land bearing R.S No.17/2, situated at NC:
2024:KHC-D:16343 Kamanakatti village in Gokak taluka, Belagavi District, to the extent of 29 gunta 1 anas. That the said land was acquired by the 2nd respondent for formation of railway line.

Consequent to the acquisition, an award bearing No.LAQ/SR/No.212/2012-13 was passed on 27.12.2014 (Annexure-A).
3.

The petitioner made an representation dated 23.01.2023 (Annexure-B) to the 2nd respondent for passing an award by awarding the benefits under Section 31 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 20131.
